scope: Eleven bounded storage responsibility domains from saved contracts plus selected source. Not a complete product storage census or verified effective-root inventory.

sourceFacts.claim: 同步home解析器xr默认preferWsl为false；回退表达式为process.env.CODEX_HOME ?? path.join(os.homedir(),`.codex`)。该表达式不trim或resolve环境值，空字符串和相对值并未在此被拒绝。
异步执行home解析器Sr在win32且preferWsl为true时先await er()，无结果回退到同一CODEX_HOME/用户home表达式；WSL helper和实际返回值未执行。
gT先以无参数o.ot()确定桌面home，再以该值构造globalState与config.toml settingsStore；runCodexInWsl和可用性确定后，另以o.st({preferWsl})求executionCodexHome。后者没有替换前两个构造路径。
userData路径候选先trim CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH并resolve；无覆盖时以appData、build flavor标签和可选agent run ID构造。该规则与CODEX_HOME解析规则不同。
bootstrap的所选Program顶层调用将oD结果传入app.setPath(`userData`,...)；实际appData、flavor、环境和运行有效路径未读取。
settingsStore的ki构造器保存filePath/globalState、读取ji(filePath)、规范化状态并准备旧设置迁移。set先更新内存与pendingWrites，再尝试persistPendingSettings；configClient为null时不提交后台写入。
ji仅在文件存在时读取UTF8并解析TOML的desktop部分；错误日志后返回空对象。该选定reader没有文件写入。
所选settingsStore.initialize输入包含config及batchWriteConfigValues回调，回调调用捕获的pt.sendAppServerRequest(`config/batchWrite`,edits)。此调用结构不证明实际pt实例、配置层或最终文件路径。
ki将pending迁移与写入快照转为desktop.<key>、mergeStrategy:replace的batch edits；确认成功后仅移除仍等于快照的pending值并调用Fi清理旧键，失败被记录且pending保留。initialize中配置已存在的项也可直接清理对应pending迁移并调用Fi，不要求一次新增写入。
Fi按descriptor.hostStorage.kind清理configuration/global-state旧键或electron persisted-atom对象成员；composerEnterBehavior另有旧项清理。具体descriptor/schema与Pi迁移取值未在本轮展开，不能按键名推定模式。
AJe为基类提供的read/write适配使用globalState的thread assignments、projectless IDs及路径hint键；另可通过writeMembership回调写后台并更新host ID。这个本地副本没有在所选类中创建独立数据库。
AJe使用的i.r导出对应U0；U0.flush先等待pendingThreadWrites和pendingCatalogWrite结算，再await pendingWrite。这个方法不调用globalState.flush，等待队列和文件提交必须分开表述。
gT在桌面home/sqlite下构造prod或带flavor后缀的codex-history-snapshots数据库名，await allSettled清理主文件、-wal、-shm、-journal。该清理不证明所有会话数据库位置或原生恢复机制。
af按persist:codex-browser-前缀和encodeURIComponent(name)构造逻辑partition名；已保存app session合同使用app名称。实际磁盘session根仍由runtime/session provider决定。
at按persist:codex-browser-app-route:前缀编码由两个输入以NUL连接的身份元组；该命名规则不能证明实际磁盘根、账号隔离或完整调用方集合。

domains.name: thread memberships与projectless路径提示

newEngineeringDecisions: Separate desktop home, execution home and Electron profile inputs; do not collapse them into one appData option.
Separate initial TOML read from app-server configuration mutation and acknowledgement-driven migration cleanup.
Membership local state is layered on globalState while backend/queue completion remains distinct from file flush.
Retain exact startup history-snapshot cleanup family; no blanket SQLite or thread-data migration.
Treat browser partition identity, native credential authority and runtime profile as separate isolation gates.

existingBehaviorEvidence.scope: 9 isolated real-file cases under Node22; schemas/defaults/comparator substituted or unused; no original store/runtime parity.
17 substituted event/timer cases; no native, real IO or original app shutdown.
Saved authorized real stop/restart outcome; interrupted turn restored; not automatic continued execution or proof of an internal storage path.

remainingCoverage: Effective appData/userData/desktop home/execution home and provider identity require an owned runtime observation; no live personal directories were inspected.
WSL home helper, settings descriptor/schema migration, backend native storage and credential selection remain explicit source/provider boundaries.

Plugin/cache/download/update-resume/automation/workspace and remote account-service storage have not received a complete per-store ownership census in this map. Do not count their feature definitions as resolved storage.
No product-wide storage denominator or complete isolation, migration, failure recovery or durability proof is claimed.
pathQualification: Inferred maintenance boundaries, not recovered original paths, added logical-owner records or generated implementation.
